LanguageData.CC_WH_Great_Belief_1: {WHAT} came of {GOD}, and not of chance.
LanguageData.CC_WH_Great_Belief_2: It was {GOD} that sent {WHAT} upon the land.
LanguageData.CC_WH_Great_Belief_3: {WHAT} is the work of {GOD}, whatsoever others may say.
LanguageData.CC_WH_Impact_Apart: Kept apart from travellers while the sickness lasts: sickness brought in by visitors, traders and couriers comes half as often, and nobody of the colony has one of the small moments with them.
LanguageData.CC_WH_Impact_ApartCool: Each group of visitors or traders kept at arm's length thinks a little less of the colony (1 goodwill).
LanguageData.CC_WH_Impact_Vow: {PAWN} keeps a vigil day each week while the holy year lasts, from tomorrow morning: most of the working day at their god's place, an altar or the gathering spot, away from work. Each one kept strengthens their belief and lifts their mood.
LanguageData.CC_WH_Impact_Side: Only {BACKED} come asking while the war lasts; {OTHER} stop asking the colony for anything.
LanguageData.CC_WH_Impact_Mourning: Outer clothes dyed dark grey until the mourning is over ({WHO}); then each piece is put back as it was.
LanguageData.CC_WH_Mourning_Dyed: The colony is in mourning colours for {NAME}: {COUNT} of its people have their outer clothes dyed dark grey until it is over.
LanguageData.CC_WH_Vigil_Kept: {PAWN} kept a vigil day, as vowed for the holy year.
LanguageData.CC_WH_Vow_Done: The holy year is over. {PAWN} kept {COUNT} vigil days, as vowed.
